snippet.title: Journey to Slimetopia - Trailer
snippet.description:
Play for free
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4052230/Journey_to_Slimetopia/

Venture into an unknown world in this first-person arena shooter. Tread on paths none have walked before and search for secrets to upgrade your weapons. Wield a sword and wand to face hordes of slimes gone mad. Meet curious characters and become the hero which Slimetopia awaits.
